UART RX (engine1) delivers at most one word per 640 cycles (10 x 64); the SPI engine returns to PULL 520 cycles after taking a word when its RX FIFO has room: the route never backs up at line rate (margin 120 cycles/word)
8 SPI return words fit the 8-word RX FIFO without host service; the 9th would stall the SPI PUSH, back up the route and end in the UART strict-PUSH fault4 (documented overload behaviour)
